title: Training-Overlap Discount on ClearPath Standard Upgrades
content:
The training-overlap discount on the upgraded rate of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement moving from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard reads the phishing simulations per year of the client's active Sentinel Managed Security tier, which the ClearPath Standard security awareness training would otherwise duplicate.

| Phishing simulations per year of the active Sentinel Managed Security tier | Discount |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 3.0 percent off |
| 1 to 11 | 1.5 percent off |
| none, or no active subscription | nothing |

The figure is a feature of the tier of the client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active.
